title: conchidium jerdonianum
intro: Conchidium jerdonianum, commonly known as the Indian pine fern, is a type of epiphytic fern native to the tropical forests of India and Southeast Asia. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems. The health benefits of Conchidium jerdonianum are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic actions.
